transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Professor Snape. How can I assist you today in procuring the finest potions ingredients for Hogwarts?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Good afternoon, nothing like that. I require a full replacement of the Re'em blood I purchased recently. It arrived in a most unsatisfactory condition.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your concern, Professor, but as per Apothecaries' Guild regulation 7, all volatile ingredients are sold as-final; evaporation during transport is the customer's responsibility. No exceptions, Professor, not even for Hogwarts staff. Is there anything else I might assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Regulation 7, you say? Then it would appear that Apothecaries' Guild regulation 8 has been conveniently overlooked. It states quite clearly that ingredients must be securely sealed upon dispatch. The vial I received was most assuredly not. This is an issue of quality control, not evaporation.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Regulation 8, indeed a crucial one. Allow me to assess the situation, Professor. If the vial seal was compromised, then it could indeed reflect a lapse in quality control rather than standard evaporation. I'll inquire further and ensure it is resolved. May I examine the vial, or is there any documentation you can provide regarding the defective seal?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see you are finally grasping the gravity of the situation. The vial is in my bag; I shall retrieve it. Documentation, you ask? I took the liberty of photographing the compromised seal with my wand the moment I discovered the issue. This should suffice as evidence of the defect.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you, Professor. The photograph will indeed suffice as documentation. Once I verify the matter, I'll see to it that a suitable replacement is arranged for you. Please leave the vial with me for inspection. Rest assured, we'll rectify this oversight promptly.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, Apothecary. I trust this matter will be resolved with the utmost urgency. Time is of the essence, as I require the ingredient for an advanced potion that cannot be delayed. I shall await your prompt attention to this issue and the expedited delivery of a replacement. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Understood, Professor Snape. I will ensure this is addressed with all due urgency and that the replacement is expedited to you at Hogwarts. Thank you for your patience and for bringing this to our attention. Good day.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I do not require your thanks. This is a professional matter, and I expect it to be handled accordingly. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, Professor. The matter will be handled professionally. Good day.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Professor Snape.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I shall not comment on the decorum of your shop or the efficacy of your staff. However, should the matter not be resolved to my satisfaction, I shall be compelled to bring this to the attention of the Apothecaries' Guild.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand, Professor. We are committed to resolving this to your satisfaction and upholding our standards. Rest assured, it will be addressed properly. Thank you for your patience.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As it should be. I trust that this incident will serve as a lesson in attention to detail for all involved. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Indeed, Professor. We strive for improvement. Good day.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I have no desire to linger here any longer than necessary. The matter has been brought to your attention, and I now expect it to be rectified without further delay. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Absolutely, Professor. We will act swiftly to rectify the situation. Good day.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I shall not be left waiting indefinitely for your action. It is imperative that the replacement be delivered to my office at Hogwarts within the next forty-eight hours. I trust you understand the urgency of this matter. Good day.
